description: This file defines a PHP class LanguageAPI within the OrangeHRM installer API namespace, extending an abstract controller for REST API functionality. It primarily handles GET requests to return a list of available languages, using a helper class to retrieve the data.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for retrieving language data during the installation process of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET HTTP requests to return a list of available languages, accessed via the InstanceCreationHelper.
